desc: Implement fast matmul (mod p) and matpow for (A')^p with tight inner loop (N=100, p≤1e9)
Implement p=2 branch: build B (zeros→1), output B^2 mod 2
Implement odd-p branch: P=(A')^p; per diagonal zero add row/column contributions; for p=3 add off-diagonal A'[v][u] terms; apply (-1)^K; output mod p
Validate against all three samples by running the code (Sample 3 exercises diagonal-zero corrections + (A')^p at p=13)
Double-check edge cases by running: N=1, K=0 (no zeros), all zeros, p=3 with mixed diagonal/off-diagonal zeros
Verify performance: ~30 matmuls of 10^6 inner ops with sparse-skip; acceptable for N=100, p≤1e9 (borderline but correct; micro-optimization optional)
